Whether the centre's stock at 4 PM Thursday (after Wednesday and Thursday collections, minus Tuesday shipment) is at least 150 units. After Tuesday shipment, stock is 220-150=70 units. Whether the centre's stock at 4 PM Tuesday (after Monday and Tuesday collections) is at least 150 units to dispatch the Tuesday shipment.
